name: linggen
description: Linggen for Claude Code — two local MCP servers, each tool served in one place: durable cross-host memory from ling-mem, browser control in your own Chrome and logged-in X reads from the Linggen engine. Per-turn memory recall built in, and /linggen:config points this host at a Linggen on another machine. Installs its required binaries (ling-mem + the Linggen engine, background download) on first session start.
